page.layout: One printed page, single text column; running head at top centre; page number top right; catchword/signature at foot left of the column ("Ff" centre, "quiescen-" right as catchword).

main_text.p: Henrici à Blodorff/ Joannis à Reuscheinberg in Luppenaw/N. ab Hocun/N. ab Hartt in Loerszberg/ Wolfgangi Caspari Adelman/ V Wolfgangi Theodoriab Hoeten/Theodori à Diepenbruch/Wilhelmi à Nesselraedt/Ioannis à Niewkirchen/Reinheri Solinandri & Ioannis Lithodii Doctorum Medicorum: V Vinandi Thomasii aulici concionatoris, Iacobi Kremer & Ioannis Kieff culinæ graphiariorum cum reliquis ad tam splendidam aulam necessariis ministris. Sponsam vero Ducalem comitatæ, Margaretha ex familia Marcana Arenbergæ & Barbansonii, Amœna à Dhaun, Falckensteinii, Gumperti Novariensis & Alpensis vidua, Comites ; vidua Hallensis aulæ præfecta Christina & Arnholda à Wachtendonck/Anna ab Hurdt/ Maria Bilandica, cum nobilissimis Buirena,Elleria, & Schureria virginibus aulicis. Ultima Augusti Siegeberga solvens,equitatum per Ten(Hundsruggen) ductoribus ei per Johannem à Reuschenberg/ Dominum in Setterich aulæ Marescalcum, Volmaro à Scheidt dicto Wesspenning/ præfecto Blanckenbergio, & Joanne Buxr constitutis VWeissenkircha Andernacum pergentes ibidem ab Hermanno Manderscheidiæ & Blanckenheimiæ Comite, Georgio à Lep Magistro aulæ provinciali V Vilhelmo ab Hoist in Heimertzen hæreditario, & Joanne Kurtzrock/ Licentiato nomine Archiepiscopi Coloniensis : Treviri vero a Friderico à Reiffenberg Galliæ Chiliarcha, Joanne Zandten à Merle/ & Conrado à Ret/licentiato verbis & muneribus excepti 1 Septembris confluentiam appulere, ubi ab ipso Electore Treviro in ripa salutati inque arcem Ehrenbretsteiniam ducti Ernestum Hennebergium cum uxore V Veitenbergia, Joannis Nassovii conjuge & Comite Reitterscheidia ex balneo sylvestri reduces, obvios habuerunt. 2 Septembris navigium cum Philippo Nassovio rursus ingressi, S. Goarini à Landgravii Philippi Cancellario D. Nordeccio accepti, & Bacharacchum 3 Septembris prætervecti, Carolo Arnsbergio comitante Bingium aspexere, ubi, cum Reichardus Palatinus per Cancellarium & nobilissimum Geispitzium, quod ipsus ob crurifragium non venisset, le excusasset, 4 Septembris Moguntiam devenere; sed prius à Marescbalco Bickenio, vice Domino Brendelio & Doctore Philippo contecto navigio in Rheno præventi,inque castrum Martinianum deducti, ex eo ab Alberto Packio Burggravio Alzeano conducti sunt. 6 Septembris igitur Moguntiâ Openheimium progressi à Philippo VVamboldo ab Umbstadt/ ad novam arcem invitati, ubi 7 Septembr. Gernsheimii in arce Moguntinâ pernoctassent, 8 VVormatiam devenerunt: quâ in urbe præfectus Germershei-mius Christophorus à Gotfarth nomine Electoris Palatini, & Ioannes Falckensteinii comes cum sorore Amœna vidua Novaquilana comparuere: Inde undecima Septembris, ad Norcum arcem exque ea Spiram 12 appulere, à Marquardo ab Hatstein Episcopo excepti. 13 post peracta sacræ Reinhusium, 14 Mulbrunnum,15 Stutgardiam sedem Ducis Wirtembergensis,& 16 ibidem quiescen-

page.notes: Black-letter names are rendered in bl tags; several proper names and the Greek-free text are doubtful, notably "Hoist", "Hartt", "Kieff", "Hatstein" and "Tenderos"; the line "Tenteros(Hundsruggen)" is partly illegible. The line "excepti" contains a stray character and may be a misprint.
